rationale: Layer 2 (ML filter) evaluated across 22 historical configurations. Under pre-registered protocol with Block Bootstrap by Day, 1000-draw Monte Carlo, and realistic friction (0.3-0.5 pt slip + 30k fee), Layer 2 failed all acceptance criteria: pooled expectancy remained negative (-0.24 to -1.20 pt/trade), 0/12 folds beat random filtering P95, and 2026 Short AUC collapsed below 0.50.

signal_specification.description: Native Wyckoff StrategySignal (8 setups: 4 Long, 4 Short) defined in trading_engine/strategy/trend.py without external post-hoc short regime filter. Pooled historical trade count (2024-01-01 to 2026-10-20): exactly 591 trades.

live_gate_criteria.purpose: Operational integrity and execution verification only; not statistical proof of small alpha edge.
live_gate_criteria.standard_error_note: With trade std dev ~8.5 pts, proving 0.5 pt edge requires ~1,200 trades (>5 years). Paper trade is an operational run-check (API latency, actual broker slippage, order routing).
live_gate_criteria.evaluation_metric: Lower bound of Block Bootstrap 95% CI of Expectancy > 0 points at actual broker friction.

margin_and_holding_policy.overnight_holding_policy: ALLOWED_BY_DEFAULT (Strategy does not force intraday flat in frozen baseline; positions held overnight until Stop Loss, Take Profit, or Reversal signal occurs. H-01 flat_before_atc evaluated as quarantined hypothesis and tracked in parallel journal paper_trade_journal_h01.csv).
margin_and_holding_policy.minimum_initial_margin_rate: 17% (Under VSDC Decision No. 13/QĐ-VSDC). At VN30F1M index 1,850 - 1,900 points, contract notional is 185M - 190M VND, requiring minimum cash margin of ~31.5M - 32.3M VND per contract (~25M - 35M VND at DNSE depending on leverage package).

exchange_and_broker_regulatory_framework.hnx_derivative_trading_rules: Quy chế niêm yết và giao dịch chứng khoán phái sinh (Quyết định số 651/QĐ-SGDHN). Phiên định kỳ đóng cửa ATC (14:30 - 14:45) chỉ tiếp nhận lệnh ATC và LO; cấm sửa/hủy lệnh; từ chối mọi lệnh thị trường (MTL, MAK, MOK). Toàn bộ lệnh khớp tại một mức giá duy nhất lúc 14:45:00.
exchange_and_broker_regulatory_framework.dnse_conditional_order_rules: Quy chế Lệnh Điều Kiện của DNSE / Entrade X: 'Lệnh điều kiện trên phái sinh chỉ được hệ thống theo dõi và kích hoạt trong các phiên giao dịch liên tục.' Trong phiên ATC (14:30 - 14:45), hệ thống DNSE không kích hoạt lệnh dừng lỗ (Stop Loss). Nếu vị thế không đóng trước 14:30, lệnh dừng lỗ hoàn toàn vô hiệu trong phiên ATC.

risk_parameters.stop_loss_architecture: Two-tier dynamic volatility-based stops: Tier 1 Soft SL (1.0 * HTF_5m_ATR conditional on HTF 15m reversal) + Tier 2 Emergency Hard SL (2.5 * HTF_5m_ATR unconditional).
risk_parameters.atr_dependence_note: Stop distances are dynamic and proportional to market volatility (HTF_5m_ATR). The 6.7 points figure is the median nominal stop (2.5 * 1.0 * median HTF_5m_ATR ~2.7). In high-volatility regimes (ATR > 4.0 pts), nominal hard stop distance expands beyond 10.0 points (max observed 28.19 pts). In low-volatility regimes (ATR < 2.0 pts), stop distance narrows to ~5.0 points.

h01_flat_before_atc_audit_matrix.description: Intraday flat before ATC at 14:25:00 open price +/- slippage. No entries opened >= 14:25. Tested across slippages 0.1, 0.3, 0.5 pt on 2024-2026 data.

pooled_findings.tail_risk_reduction: Eliminates catastrophic ATC gap loss (max loss drops from 80.10 to 28.19 pts; P99 loss drops from 19.74 to 14.93 pts at 0.1 slip).
pooled_findings.expectancy_drag: Kills overnight continuation gains on winning trends. Pooled expectancy changes by -0.25 pt [-0.80, +0.33] at 0.1 slip; -0.19 pt [-0.72, +0.37] at 0.3 slip; -0.14 pt [-0.67, +0.43] at 0.5 slip.
pooled_findings.statistical_conclusion: 95% CI crosses zero across all slippage levels. No evidence of net positive expectancy improvement on historical data. Remains quarantined for forward paper testing.

search_budget_and_tested_setups_registry.protocol_enforcement: Strict historical freeze on 2018-2026 foundation. Zero parameter optimization allowed after viewing results. All candidate setups quarantined in parallel shadow journal (paper_trade_journal_shadow.csv) without touching frozen Layer 1 baseline.

candidate_shadow_setups_evaluation_matri.protocol: Single one-shot evaluation on 2018-2026 (529k bars), gap-aware execution, 0.3 & 0.5 pt slippage + 30k fee, Block Bootstrap by Day (5-day blocks, 2000 draws, 95% CI), Matched Random Null Baseline (same hour & direction distribution, 100 MC draws).

PULLBACK_15M_TREND.description: Enters when HTF_15m_TrendOK=1 (Long) or TrendDownOK=1 (Short) and 5m candle closes in trend direction after touching 5m EMA20. Exits via standard ATR stops and trailing.
PULLBACK_15M_TREND.finding: Gross edge (+0.41 pt) is wholly consumed by friction (0.9-1.3 pt round-trip). Alpha vs random baseline is statistically indistinguishable from zero (p=0.30).

OPENING_RANGE_BREAK.description: Opening range 09:00-09:15; after 09:15 enters on breakout with RVOL >= 1.2. Fixed stop 4.0 points, trailing stop.

first_breakout_of_day.finding: Shows statistically significant positive directional edge over random baseline (+0.32 pt alpha, p < 0.001) and strictly caps tail risk (Max Loss 5.10 pts). However, gross margin (+0.53 pt) remains below round-trip friction, rendering net expectancy negative without friction reduction.
